answer: Make caught fraud destroy capital rather than recycle it. Each identity locks a bond before it can earn, keyed under a cipher of its own; when a single cheat is proven, the whole deposit is not refunded to anyone but BURNED off the ledge, permanently removed from supply. This kills the victim-refund collusion loop a payout pool invites, and leaves the attacker's stake as a dead anchor dragged to the bottom: a farmer funding a hundred bonds forfeits real capital that nobody recovers, so expected value stays strictly negative.
